name: decision-ledger
what: Every question marked for the person is recorded, shown again until answered, and leaves the list only by their words or a stated reason.

faults.fault: A question with no recommendation is never sent back.
The same open list is shown on every prompt.
faults.find: if (seen.sig === sig && now - seen.shown_at < DAY) return null;

faults.fault: An answer with empty words is accepted.
A question with no recommendation is recorded before it is sent back, so the retry leaves two decisions.
The folder is created without a .gitignore, so git add . can commit the ledger.
Old state files are never deleted.
State files younger than 30 days are deleted too.
